steps.title: Analyze Existing Structure and User Specifications
steps.description: Audit the present Smart Notes app to integrate a native 3D UI perspective effect and multi-frequency retro synthesized audio capabilities.

steps.title: Implement ThreeDLinearLayout.java View Class
steps.description: Create a custom view subclassing LinearLayout that detects touch coordinates and applies real-time 3D perspective rotation using rotationX, rotationY, and Z-translation values with correct camera distance.

steps.title: Develop Synthesized Audio SoundManager.java
steps.description: Write a high-performance, self-contained SoundManager using the native AudioTrack class to dynamically synthesize clicking, deletion whooshes, success chime arpeggios, and opening sounds on-the-fly.

steps.title: Design 3D Layered Card Background Drawable
steps.description: Define card_3d_bg.xml as a layer-list shape showing a real 3D depth border and shadow offsets.

steps.title: Design Action 3D Button Drawables
steps.description: Construct pressed and default layer-list states in btn_3d_action.xml, btn_3d_accent.xml, btn_3d_green.xml, and btn_3d_gray.xml drawables for full 3D interactive button clicks.

steps.title: Refactor layout_note_item.xml Design Template
steps.description: Update the list item layout to wrap contents in ThreeDLinearLayout with the custom card depth background to give notes a premium 3D look and feel.

steps.title: Upgrade activity_main.xml User Interface Layout
steps.description: Integrate the 3D-styled header sections, custom 3D state buttons, and frame card layouts to align the search panels and filter views with the new 3D design paradigm.

steps.title: Integrate Synthesized Sound Triggers in NoteAdapter.java
steps.description: Embed click sound responses in the Edit and Delete button tap listeners inside the Adapter.

steps.title: Update MainActivity.java for Multi-Sound & Initializer Logic
steps.description: Wire multiple distinct audio signals into the note save, delete, cancel, editor-open, and filter action listeners while preventing sound triggers during app setup.

steps.title: Perform Java 8 and Manifest Standard Audits
steps.description: Verify the code for total compatibility with target compilation environments and check correct packaging and build settings.

steps.title: Building Smart Notes
steps.description: Compile, package, and build the APK release file for Smart Notes.
